name: TUM VI
summary: 室内外视觉惯性序列，提供校准后的双目图像、IMU 与部分或完整运动捕捉轨迹。
summaryEn: Indoor and outdoor visual-inertial sequences with calibrated stereo images, IMU, and partial or full motion-capture trajectories.
scale: Room, corridor, hall, outdoor and slide sequences
scaleZh: 涵盖房间、走廊、大厅、室外和滑道序列
licenseZh: 数据为 CC BY 4.0；代码为 BSD-2-Clause
access: Official raw and calibrated sequence downloads
accessZh: 官方原始及校准序列下载
wmNote: 房间序列提供完整位姿真值；其他主要序列仅起止段有真值，评测需遵守该覆盖范围。
wmNoteEn: Room sequences have full pose truth; other main sequences only have start/end truth, limiting pose evaluation coverage.
